strongest_angle: The Makkah Clock Tower in Saudi Arabia achieved two Guinness World Records on January 5, 2026, by housing the world's highest museum in a building and highest outdoor observation deck at 426.875 metres above ground.

key_facts.fact: The Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites achieved the Guinness World Record for the highest museum in a building at 426.875 metres on January 5, 2026.
The Makkah Clock Tower overlooks the Grand Mosque in Saudi Arabia and earned two new Guinness World Records for its museum and outdoor observation deck.
The Clock Tower Museum in Mecca stands 426.875 metres above ground, setting a new Guinness World Record recognized by Gulf News.

named_entities.name: Royal Commission for Makkah City and Holy Sites
